photo_observations.observations: Actual Donald Cameron low wet-rock patch viewed: fine hair-like bare culms with tiny oval tips, creeping colony. GoBotany0.2-0.7mm stems,1-2mm heads cannot resolve25mm; choose10-18cm young leafless needle colony without inflated brown heads.

findings: Inspected all36current variants and seeds1/4/7 at small/medium/large scales. Rejected first overly dense32-culm patch; reduced to14 and widened spacing. Current10-23cm colony has separate tips and open larger patches; small compact seeds still merge strongly at25mm. True0.2-0.7mm stems and1-2mm heads are not reproducible; no inflated heads.
